SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_qty, avg_cost_ratio, color_rank
FROM (
  SELECT grouped.*,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY product_color
           ORDER BY avg_qty DESC NULLS LAST
         ) AS color_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT ili.order_item_id,
           p.product_color,
           AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty,
           AVG(
             (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) /
             NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)
           ) AS avg_cost_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
    GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
  ) AS grouped
)
WHERE color_rank <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, color_rank, order_item_id
